title: FedQuest typed query graph, typed-v1
description: The restricted, typed query FedQuest's front end writes for a question (fedquest.methods.compiler: grammar, semantics and the execution contract). A conjunctive query with access limitations: atoms are relations a read materializes, filters selections on one variable, shared variables joins, constants selections, the answer its projection. Every field but atoms may be absent; uses (a typed-v1 addition) is derived from the relation when absent.

constants.description: The names the question gives, written as in the question; never a guessed value.

answer.description: The variable whose values answer the question; null for yes/no, a choice between named items or what both sides of a comparison share (every variable is then awaited).

form.description: What the answer is; yes/no and choice await every variable.

name.description: A constant: a name the question gives.

variable.description: An unknown; a placeholder (a type and a number: ?person2) may be named inside a relation.

evidence.description: What can state the fact: texts and tables, or only an image (its appearance, what it shows). Absent: text.

set.description: Several members: the variable binds to a set (a list read).

relation.description: A short phrase read from subject to object.

uses.description: The variables the relation names inside it (?person1 | married ?person2 in | ?date1): bound before the atom is read, their values written into the relation. Absent: derived from the relation.

condition.description: A condition on the variable alone.
